content.short: Stream payroll by the second, spend with crypto cards and manage business payments on Zebec Network, which started on Solana.
content.description: Zebec started on Solana with a simple idea: pay people continuously, not once a month. Zebec Payroll streams salaries by the second, so earned pay is available right away. Zebec Cards let users spend crypto at regular merchants, and the Zebec App ties accounts together. The network now spans many chains and serves a large base of business customers. ZBCN is its token. It has built decentralized payments infrastructure since 2021, reports more than 250 enterprise clients, and is opening a super app for earning, spending and staking in early access.
